verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments/banking SaaS. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only API docs, an MCP docs server, llms.txt and product features, with no open-source repository or license, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
